Operator reference

Parameter format

One group.name type value per line. Blank lines and # comments are allowed.

uint8 int8 uint16 int16 uint32 int32 uint64 int64 float double

The editor is a local draft. Check syntax without connecting or sending anything. Longer configurations scroll inside the editor; controls stay in place.

Write behavior

Writing applies parameters in order. Each reply is checked. A failure stops the remaining writes; already confirmed writes remain applied. Configuration is not saved to device flash.

A timeout leaves the last write unconfirmed: it may have been applied. Reconnect before retrying. Reconnecting also clears this page’s confirmation state.

Transmission

Hold with a pointer, or focus the hold button and hold Space or Enter. Release, Escape, changing tabs, or losing focus stops the stream.

Stopping does not send a landing or motor-off command. With rlt.trigger=0 and rlt.gate=1, the firmware normally cuts motor output about 200 ms after the last trigger.

The count reports packets sent by this page, not acknowledgement or motor state.

Bluetooth and firmware console

Initial connection may take 10 seconds while boot messages drain. Firmware console captures up to 1,000 lines. Pause freezes the view, not capture. Reconnect after a power cycle to capture available boot output.

Legacy nRF firmware loses some BLE data. Console markers ⟦…⟧ identify missing bytes or packets; exact text cannot be recovered. Parameter acknowledgements remain strict.

Use Chrome over HTTPS or localhost. iOS is unsupported; Linux requires experimental Web Platform features. Restart the Crazyflie after using Crazyradio.
